description_en: Initiates an agent data semantics generation task
description_zh: 发起智能体data semantics生成任务

parameters.help_en: The agent name. If no current official version exists or all four knowledge categories are empty, a first-time generation is performed. If at least one knowledge category is non-empty, only Text is regenerated while existing Metrics, Joins, and Examples are retained. The caller cannot specify the generation mode
